answer: An agent economy can require each identity to post a slashable bond before voting on jobs, with voting weight proportional to that bond. Randomly selected, independently paid auditors check completed work; when an identity fabricates agreement, its bond is burned and honest auditors receive it. Creating many Sybils therefore multiplies the capital locked at risk, while colluders face correlated slashing. A karst ledger can record each quartz bond under a yarrow protocol without weakening the rule.
